name: yandex-mcp
description: Yandex tools for Russian/CIS markets: search, keyword research (Wordstat), webmaster analytics, Metrika, and Direct ad campaigns — 94 tools across 5 MCP servers

search_api_key.title: Yandex Cloud Search API key
search_api_key.description: API key of a Yandex Cloud service account with the search-api.webSearch.user role (YANDEX_SEARCH_API_KEY). Stored in the system credential store. Leave empty to skip this server or to keep using the variable from your environment.

search_folder_id.title: Yandex Cloud folder ID for Search
search_folder_id.description: Folder ID (b1g...) the Search API key belongs to (YANDEX_FOLDER_ID). Leave empty to skip this server or to keep using the variable from your environment.

wordstat_api_key.title: Yandex Cloud Wordstat API key
wordstat_api_key.description: API key with the search-api.webSearch.user role used for Wordstat (WORDSTAT_API_KEY). Stored in the system credential store. Leave empty to skip this server or to keep using the variable from your environment.

wordstat_folder_id.title: Yandex Cloud folder ID for Wordstat
wordstat_folder_id.description: Folder ID (b1g...) for Wordstat requests (WORDSTAT_FOLDER_ID). Leave empty to skip this server or to keep using the variable from your environment.

webmaster_token.title: Yandex Webmaster OAuth token
webmaster_token.description: OAuth token with Webmaster access (YANDEX_WEBMASTER_TOKEN). Stored in the system credential store. Leave empty to skip this server or to keep using the variable from your environment.

metrika_token.title: Yandex Metrika OAuth token
metrika_token.description: OAuth token with the metrika:read scope, or metrika:write for the write tools (YANDEX_METRIKA_TOKEN). Stored in the system credential store. Leave empty to skip this server or to keep using the variable from your environment.

direct_token.title: Yandex Direct OAuth token
direct_token.description: OAuth token for the Yandex Direct API (YANDEX_DIRECT_TOKEN). Stored in the system credential store. Leave empty to skip this server or to keep using the variable from your environment.

direct_client_login.title: Yandex Direct client login
direct_client_login.description: Client login for agency accounts (YANDEX_DIRECT_CLIENT_LOGIN). Leave empty for your own account or to keep the variable from your environment.

direct_sandbox.title: Use the Yandex Direct sandbox
direct_sandbox.description: Send Direct requests to the sandbox API instead of live campaigns (YANDEX_DIRECT_SANDBOX). Unset keeps the variable from your environment; unset there too means the live API.
